parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 500 (default 100). An invalid value is 400 invalid-limit.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor taken from nextCursor of the previous page; repeat the filters on every page. An undecodable value is 400 invalid-cursor. Any other undeclared query parameter is 400 unknown-query-parameter.
